oracle_provenance.method: constant-current charge to the voltage limit followed by a constant-voltage hold to the termination current
oracle_provenance.pass_tol_basis: flat 5% of the reference value. The band exists to catch a wrong configuration, not to grade numerical precision; the nearest wrong configuration for this track lands ~68% away, and the structural failures are caught by the gates.
oracle_provenance.gross_error_tol_basis: 20% of the reference value; diagnostic only, not part of the score
oracle_provenance.ocv_max_deviation_basis: 1.4x the reference run's own worst departure from the evaluator's open-circuit-voltage curve, plus 50 mV
oracle_provenance.gt_type_note: Parameter-set-specific solver reference, not a measurement on a physical cell: the task asks for what this parameterisation predicts.

charge_time_s.description: Total charge time of the Prada2013 cell over a constant-current charge at 1.1C from 26% state of charge up to 3.6 V, followed by a constant-voltage hold at 3.6 V until the current falls to 30 mA.
